podcast.body: This song is featured on the "Yes Please" album and is described as a great tune. The album it comes from is noted for marking the end of the Madchester era. "The Happy Mondays and Stinking Thinking from the Yes Please album, the record that pretty much marked the end of whatever Madchester was."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
